# Jaco CMS

> The CMS that turns static HTML into editable pages.
> No database, no build step — PHP 8.2+ on a typical shared host.

## What it is

Jaco CMS is a PHP 8.2+ CMS that turns static HTML into editable pages. Site content lives as `.html` files in
the web root; editable regions are marked with `data-jaco-*` attributes. An
admin SPA (Mithril.js) runs in `/jaco/` and talks to a PHP API. All changes
are backed up before writing.

## Key directories

- `jaco/` — application (admin UI, API, PHP code, vendor). Replaced on update.
- `jaco-data/` — operator data: settings.php, templates, backups, runtime logs. Never served.
- `media/` — editor uploads, served as static files.
- `docs/` — maintainer documentation (index: docs/readme.md).

## Architecture

- **Backend**: PHP 8.2+, no framework, layered (core/domain/api/cli). Deptrac rules in `jaco/deptrac.yaml`.
- **Frontend**: Mithril.js SPA, no build step, hash routes in `jaco/frontend/app.js`.
- **No database**: pages are `.html` files; backups in `jaco-data/backups/`.
- **Auth**: JWT (HS256), roles `editor`/`admin`, optional per-user TOTP, login throttle per address.
- **Config**: `jaco-data/settings.php` overrides defaults from `create_default_config()`.

## Conventions

- Commit messages: `fix:`, `feat:`, `style:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:` — short subject, English.
- User-visible strings in all four language files: `jaco/language/{en,de,fr,it}.json`.
- Tests: PHPUnit (`composer test`), QUnit (`node jaco/test/js/runner.mjs`), Playwright E2E.
- Static analysis: PHPStan, PHP CS Fixer, Deptrac.
- PHP naming: `verb_object`, `get_`/`find_`/`read_`/`load_`, `is_`/`has_`/`can_` predicates. See `docs/backend-naming.md`.

## Key invariants

- Nothing is touched without a backup (`page/update`, `page/update-body`, `page/delete`, `css/update`, `upload/delete`).
- The app directory `jaco/` is out of reach for page operations (path guard).
- Only YouTube embeds survive sanitizing; event handlers never survive.
- Uploads are never overwritten (name collision gets `-1` appended).
- Roles gate every API route; a route without an explicit role needs `admin`.
- `readOnly` accounts keep their role but the router refuses every write.

## Self-update

- CLI: `php jaco/cli.php sys:check-update` / `sys:update [-t version] [-u url]`
- Web: System page → "Check for updates" → "Install update"
- Only `jaco/` is replaced; settings, backups, runtime, templates, media and public pages stay.
- Backup of previous `jaco/` is stored in `jaco-data/app-backups/` (directory copy, 5 retained).
- Downgrades are rejected; only HTTPS URLs (or file:// for local testing) accepted.
- Requires `zip` extension or `unzip` binary for extraction.
